verdict.credibility_line: Guides revenue conservatively and beats on profit, but many medium-term commitments remain unverified.

promises.promise: Target full-year AUM growth of 18% for FY26; can only test via revenue because AUM is not provided.
promises.delivered: Mar 2026 fiscal revenue was 2683 cr, up 14% from 2355 cr in Mar 2025.

promises.promise: Grow NIM by 18% YoY in FY26; net total income growth was only 14% in FY26.
promises.delivered: FY26 PAT of 655 cr rose 14% from 574 cr, below the 18% growth implied by FY25.

guidance_now: Borrowing and net-worth growth promises can only be partially checked from provided figures.
AUM, NIM, credit cost, opex ratio and disbursement targets are not directly measurable here.
bull: FY26 profit of 655 cr beat the 18% growth path implied by FY25 results.
Q2 FY26 PAT rose 15% YoY to 164 cr, above the stated 11% Q2 target.
Fixed assets grew to 178 cr by Mar 2026, showing tangible capacity investment progress.
bear: Profit growth slowed to +10% in Sep 2026, despite confident revenue commitments.
FY27 targets are still too early, leaving only partially visible early-quarter progress.
Branch, productivity and credit-cost promises remain hard to verify from provided financials.
questions: Why did profit growth slow to 10% in Sep 2026 after the FY26 beat?
Which FY27 inputs are management most confident about: pricing, volume or credit costs?
